messages:
drew-pm: Quick idea 1: rename Design Partner -> 'Pilot Partner Runway' and make a lighter commitment tier for early integrators who need low friction. want to sketch rules for recruitment + launch gates. thoughts?

nisha-ux: Like the rename. Suggest we define three commitment tiers: trial (2 weeks, low-touch), partner (8-12 weeks, weekly syncs), anchor (longer, co-marketing). Each with clear handoff docs.

rohan-eng: From eng: must require partners to run our automated eval harness and expose limited telemetry (latency, error rates) via a temporary token. For trial tier, basic metrics only. For partner/anchor tiers we need prompt-level diffs.

max-sre: Ops constraints: for Hosted we can onboard trials within 48h. For Dedicated/Private we need infra lead time 7-10 days and a signed SOW. Also propose a soft SLA for trials (p50 target) and stricter SLA for partner/anchor.

sophie-ops: Incentive framework: trial = $1k credits + onboarding guide; partner = $7k credits + 2 onboarding sessions + prioritized support; anchor = custom pricing + co-promo. Include opt-out after onboarding milestone.

drew-pm: Good. Launch gates proposal: 1) onboarding checklist passed, 2) eval harness >=85% on partner prompt set, 3) no P0 on infra for 72h, 4) canary for new features passes.

rohan-eng: Add code-level guardrails: feature flags + canary at 5% traffic. Also need a data-sharing TOU template for partners to accept telemetry collection. I'll drop a draft.

nisha-ux: Feedback cadence: trial = weekly async feedback + 30-min wrap; partner = weekly 1:1 + shared Figma board and triage tickets; anchor = dedicated PM channel + weekly product demos.

max-sre: Runbook thresholds: if error rate >1.5% sustained for 10m or p95 latency >3x baseline, initiate rollback and notify partner contact + SRE oncall. We'll auto-fallback to previous model variant where possible.

sophie-ops: Recruitment targets: prefer customers with existing LLM usage >=500 reqs/day, cross-functional sponsor (PM/Eng), and ability to commit prompt set. We'll offer a short intake form and scoring rubric.

drew-pm: Action owners: nisha draft tiered onboarding checklist by Tue, rohan send eval harness + TOU by Wed, max prepare runbook and thresholds by Wed, sophie write incentive language and intake form by Thu. I'll compile and run a partner intake pilot next week.

eng-bot: Reminder: create calendar 'Pilot Partner Runway kickoff' when onboarding doc is ready 1. Use /poll to propose times.

nisha-ux: small UX ask: keep partner portal minimal 1: onboarding steps, link to eval, contact, and rollback status. I'll mock a wireframe.

rohan-eng: Also propose a success metric dashboard: activation time, 14/30 day retention, prompt diversity, and model regression score. We'll instrument these for the partner cohort.

drew-pm: Great. We'll review this draft in next product sync and finalize language for legal & sales. Thanks everyone.
